entry.title: Founding communities: growing without an algorithm
entry.summary: Sovereign has no 'explore' tab or trending — by design. How does a community grow like that? By invitation, not impressions.

entry.title: What leaves your computer: the egress table
entry.summary: Privacy isn't a promise — it's an inventory. Every network egress path in the app lives in a table generated from code, and the site shows it.

entry.title: Actually offline-first: what happens when the network drops
entry.summary: The app doesn't 'degrade' without internet — it operates in full local mode and syncs signed events when connectivity returns.

entry.title: Why Sovereign Social exists
entry.summary: The communities that shaped the Brazilian internet disappeared with Orkut. This project exists so the next generation doesn't depend on a company's quarterly balance sheet.
